verdictRationale: The v3 spec closes the two remaining verification ambiguities with enforceable digest canonicalization and registry-fragment merge semantics. Under adversarial reading, the severe safety invariants now have concrete policy, manifest, planning, re-gating, and validation hooks rather than prose-only intent.

falsifiability.failureCondition: A registry additive update with a valid artifact fragment but an existing unrelated local registry entry is rejected or overwrites the local entry.
falsifiability.observableSignal: The planned or applied registry file either drops a pre-existing local key or changes its value after merge.
falsifiability.measurementMethod: Create a local registry with one customer-added key, apply a manifest fragment adding a different key, then compare parsed pre/post registries and assert all pre-existing keys retain identical values.
falsifiability.threshold: zero pre-existing local keys deleted or changed

ledgerReview.rationale: The manifest now requires explicit files[] entries and per-write traceability, and planning refuses writes without exactly one matching file entry.
Missing or inconsistent customer policy now fails closed as pinned_version for apply while non-writing commands remain available.
The approval artifact is now plan-bound by install id, manifest digest, plan digest, operation ids, and expiration.
Path safety is explicit, repeated before writes, and covers containment, symlink escapes, local-only targets, and registry path restrictions.
UPDATE_POLICY.md has required canonical YAML frontmatter, field enums, consistency rules, and fail-closed behavior for prose-only or invalid policy.
The spec now defines RFC 8785 canonicalization over the manifest with only manifest_digest and signature omitted, including duplicate-key and signature byte-range handling.
The registry merge digest now applies to the canonical artifact fragment, while merge invariants preserve local entries and block conflicts.

preserveList.summary: The spec keeps Notion mirror-only and preserves local check, plan, apply, rollback, and status without a Notion dependency.
The pre-write re-gate is strong: it repeats path, checksum, artifact, policy, approval, and registry invariant checks immediately before writes.
Telemetry is constrained by an explicit allowlist and fails closed before sending if any forbidden key appears.
